quote: A sphinx is a mythical creature with the body of a lion, most often with a human head and sometimes with wings.

statement.id: Sphinx adalah makhluk mitos bertubuh singa dan biasanya berkepala manusia, kadang bersayap.
statement.en: A sphinx is a mythical creature with a lion's body, usually a human head, and sometimes wings.

quote: The sphinx, a mythological creature with a lion's body and a human head, originated in Egypt and has been known throughout the eastern Mediterranean since the Bronze Age.

statement.id: Motif sphinx berasal dari Mesir dan dikenal di Mediterania timur sejak Zaman Perunggu.
statement.en: The sphinx motif originated in Egypt and was known across the eastern Mediterranean in the Bronze Age.

quote: The Greeks represented the sphinx as a winged lioness with a woman's head.

statement.id: Orang Yunani menggambarkannya sebagai singa betina bersayap dan berkepala perempuan.
statement.en: Greek art portrayed the sphinx as a winged lioness with a woman's head.

quote: THE SPHINX was a female monster with the body of a lion, the head and breast of a woman, eagle's wings and, according to some, a serpent's tail.

statement.id: Sphinx Yunani digambarkan memiliki tubuh singa, bagian atas perempuan, dan sayap elang; sebagian versi menambah ekor ular.
statement.en: The Greek sphinx has a lion's body, woman's upper body, eagle wings, and sometimes a serpent tail.

quote: Statues of sphinxes flanked the entrance of tombs or crowned grave markers, guarding against and punishing those who would disturb the dead.

statement.id: Arca sphinx ditempatkan di makam sebagai penjaga dari pengganggu orang mati.
statement.en: Sphinx statues guarded tombs against disturbance.

quote: Anyone who dared to answer the riddle and failed to do so correctly was killed and devoured by the sphinx.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Thebes, Sphinx memangsa orang yang gagal menjawab teka-tekinya.
statement.en: In the Theban myth, the sphinx devoured those who failed her riddle.

quote: Oedipus took up the challenge and gave the correct answer —man— and in frustration and anger the sphinx leapt to her death from the acropolis of Thebes.

statement.id: Oedipus menjawab 'manusia', lalu Sphinx melompat hingga tewas.
statement.en: Oedipus answered 'human' and the sphinx leapt to her death.

quote: The most famous sphinx plagued the city of Thebes, devouring anyone who gave the wrong answer to her riddle: what is that which has one voice and yet becomes four-footed, two-footed, and three-footed?

statement.id: Teka-teki Sphinx menanyakan makhluk bersuara satu yang berjalan dengan empat, dua, dan tiga kaki.
statement.en: The sphinx's riddle asks what has one voice and four, two, then three feet.

quote: She was sent by the gods to plague the town of Thebes as punishment for some ancient crime, preying on its youths and devouring all who failed to solve her riddle.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, para dewa mengirim Sphinx untuk menimpakan bencana pada kota Thebes sebagai hukuman atas kejahatan lama; ia memangsa para pemuda dan melahap semua yang gagal memecahkan teka-tekinya.
statement.en: According to Theoi, the gods sent the Sphinx to plague the town of Thebes as punishment for some ancient crime; she preyed on its youths and devoured all who failed to solve her riddle.

quote: In archaic vase paintings they often appear amongst a procession of animals and fabulous creatures such as lions and bird-bodied sirens.

statement.id: Dalam lukisan vas arkais, sphinx sering muncul di tengah arak-arakan hewan dan makhluk ajaib seperti singa dan siren berbadan burung.
statement.en: In archaic vase paintings, sphinxes often appear among a procession of animals and fabulous creatures such as lions and bird-bodied sirens.

quote: But she [Khimaira (Chimera)] also, in love with Orthos (Orthus), mothered the deadly Sphinx, the bane of the Kadmeians (Cadmeans) [Thebans].
locator: Classical Literature Quotes: Hesiod, Theogony 326 ff

statement.id: Menurut kutipan Theogony karya Hesiodos di Theoi, Khimaira, yang jatuh cinta pada Orthos, melahirkan Sphinx yang mematikan, bencana bagi bangsa Kadmos (Thebes).
statement.en: In the quotation from Hesiod's Theogony on Theoi, Khimaira, in love with Orthos, mothered the deadly Sphinx, the bane of the Kadmeians (Thebans).

quote: For Hera sent the Sphinx, ... whose mother was Echidna and her father Typhon; and she had the face of a woman, the breast and feet and tail of a lion, and the wings of a bird.

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, Hera mengirim Sphinx, yang ibunya Echidna dan ayahnya Typhon; ia berwajah perempuan, berdada, berkaki, dan berekor singa, serta bersayap burung.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, Hera sent the Sphinx, whose mother was Echidna and father Typhon; she had a woman's face, a lion's breast, feet, and tail, and a bird's wings.

quote: And having learned a riddle from the Muses, she sat on Mount Phicium, and propounded it to the Thebans.

statement.id: Setelah mempelajari teka-teki dari para Muse, Sphinx duduk di Gunung Phicium dan mengajukannya kepada orang Thebes.
statement.en: Having learned a riddle from the Muses, the Sphinx sat on Mount Phicium and put it to the Thebans.

quote: so they often met and discussed the answer, and when they could not find it the Sphinx used to snatch away one of them and gobble him up.

statement.id: Orang Thebes sering berkumpul membahas jawabannya, dan bila tidak menemukannya, Sphinx menyambar salah satu dari mereka lalu melahapnya.
statement.en: The Thebans often met to discuss the answer, and when they could not find it the Sphinx snatched one of them and gobbled him up.

quote: Oedipus found the solution, declaring that the riddle of the Sphinx referred to man; for as a babe he is four-footed, going on four limbs, as an adult he is two-footed, and as an old man he gets besides a third support in a staff.

statement.id: Oedipus menemukan jawabannya: teka-teki Sphinx merujuk pada manusia, yang saat bayi berkaki empat, saat dewasa berkaki dua, dan saat tua mendapat penopang ketiga berupa tongkat.
statement.en: Oedipus found the solution: the riddle referred to man, who as a babe goes on four limbs, as an adult on two feet, and as an old man gets a third support in a staff.

quote: Hesiod tells us in his Theogony that the creature was born from the Chimaera (a fire-breathing monster with three heads and a body part lion, goat, snake and dragon) and was sister to the Nemean lion and half-sister of Kerberos (the three-headed dog that guarded Hades).

statement.id: Menurut Theogony karya Hesiodos, Sphinx lahir dari Chimaira, saudari Singa Nemea, dan saudari tiri Kerberos.
statement.en: According to Hesiod's Theogony, the sphinx was born from the Chimaera, sister of the Nemean lion and half-sister of Kerberos.

quote: The sphinx created drought and famine and would only leave the Thebans alone if they solved her riddle.

statement.id: Sphinx menimbulkan kekeringan dan kelaparan dan hanya akan membiarkan orang Thebes jika mereka memecahkan teka-tekinya.
statement.en: The sphinx brought drought and famine and would leave the Thebans alone only if they solved her riddle.

quote: Sphinxes were first created by the Egyptians and usually wore a nemes (head-dress) as worn by Pharaohs.

statement.id: Sphinx pertama kali dibuat oleh bangsa Mesir dan biasanya mengenakan nemes (tutup kepala) seperti yang dipakai para firaun.
statement.en: Sphinxes were first created by the Egyptians and usually wore a nemes (head-dress) like those worn by pharaohs.

quote: In the reign of Chephren, sphinxes became more widespread and they were usually placed as guards outside or beside a mortuary temple, tomb or funerary monument.

statement.id: Pada masa pemerintahan Chephren, sphinx makin tersebar dan biasanya ditempatkan sebagai penjaga di luar atau di samping kuil pemakaman, makam, atau monumen pemakaman.
statement.en: In the reign of Chephren, sphinxes became more widespread and were usually placed as guards outside or beside a mortuary temple, tomb, or funerary monument.

quote: There is a story that in the Eighteenth Dynasty, Pharaoh Thutmose IV, when he was a mere prince, went on a hunting expedition and fell asleep in the shadow of the Sphinx. Whilst asleep he dreamt that the Sphinx spoke to him and promised that he would become king if he cleared the sands that had accumulated around the feet of the statue.

statement.id: Ada kisah bahwa Thutmose IV, saat masih pangeran, tertidur di bayangan Sphinx dan bermimpi Sphinx berjanji ia akan menjadi raja jika membersihkan pasir di kaki patung itu.
statement.en: There is a story that Thutmose IV, still a prince, fell asleep in the shadow of the Sphinx and dreamt that it promised he would become king if he cleared the sand around the statue's feet.

quote: Large, sculpted sphinxes in the shape of winged bulls often stood in pairs outside palaces and guarded against evil forces.

statement.id: Sphinx pahatan besar berbentuk banteng bersayap sering berdiri berpasangan di luar istana dan menjaga dari kekuatan jahat.
statement.en: Large sculpted sphinxes in the shape of winged bulls often stood in pairs outside palaces and guarded against evil forces.

quote: Indeed, one of the most famous sphinxes was discovered at Delphi; originally sat on a 10m high Ionic column, it had been dedicated to the oracle by the Naxians around 560 BCE.

statement.id: Salah satu sphinx paling terkenal ditemukan di Delphi; semula bertengger di atas tiang Ionia setinggi 10 m dan dipersembahkan kepada oracle oleh orang Naxos sekitar 560 SM.
statement.en: One of the most famous sphinxes was found at Delphi; it originally sat on a 10 m Ionic column and was dedicated to the oracle by the Naxians around 560 BCE.

quote: Sphinxes were also present in the art of the Minoan and Mycenaean cultures from the early second millennium BC.

statement.id: Sphinx juga hadir dalam seni budaya Minoa dan Mikenai sejak awal milenium kedua SM.
statement.en: Sphinxes were also present in the art of the Minoan and Mycenaean cultures from the early second millennium BC.

quote: The word sphinx comes from the Greek Σφίγξ, associated by folk etymology with the verb σφίγγω (sphíngō), meaning "to squeeze", "to tighten up".

statement.id: Kata sphinx berasal dari bahasa Yunani Σφίγξ, yang menurut etimologi rakyat dikaitkan dengan kata kerja σφίγγω (sphíngō) yang berarti "meremas" atau "mengencangkan".
statement.en: The word sphinx comes from the Greek Σφίγξ, associated by folk etymology with the verb σφίγγω (sphíngō), meaning "to squeeze" or "to tighten up".

quote: According to Hesiod, the Sphinx was a daughter of Orthrus and an unknown she—either the Chimera, Echidna, or Ceto. According to Apollodorus and Lasus, she was a daughter of Echidna and Typhon.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiodos, Sphinx putri Orthrus dan seorang perempuan yang tidak jelas (Chimera, Echidna, atau Ceto); menurut Apollodorus dan Lasus, putri Echidna dan Typhon.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, the Sphinx was a daughter of Orthrus and an unknown female (the Chimera, Echidna, or Ceto); according to Apollodorus and Lasus, a daughter of Echidna and Typhon.

quote: The sphinx was the emblem of the ancient city-state of Chios, and appeared on seals and the obverse side of coins from the 6th century BC until the 3rd century AD.

statement.id: Sphinx adalah lambang negara-kota kuno Chios dan muncul pada segel serta sisi depan koin dari abad ke-6 SM hingga abad ke-3 M.
statement.en: The sphinx was the emblem of the ancient city-state of Chios and appeared on seals and the obverse of coins from the 6th century BC until the 3rd century AD.

quote: The exact riddle asked by the Sphinx was not specified by early tellers of the myth, and was not standardized as the one given below until late in Greek history.

statement.id: Teka-teki yang tepat dari Sphinx tidak ditentukan oleh para penutur awal mitos dan baru dibakukan pada akhir sejarah Yunani.
statement.en: The exact riddle asked by the Sphinx was not specified by early tellers of the myth and was standardized only late in Greek history.

quote: It was said in late lore that Hera or Ares sent the Sphinx from her Aethiopian homeland (the Greeks always remembered the foreign origin of the Sphinx) to Thebes in Greece

statement.id: Menurut cerita akhir, Hera atau Ares mengirim Sphinx dari tanah airnya di Aethiopia ke Thebes di Yunani; orang Yunani selalu mengingat asal asingnya.
statement.en: In late lore, Hera or Ares sent the Sphinx from her Aethiopian homeland to Thebes in Greece; the Greeks always remembered her foreign origin.

quote: Bested at last, the Sphinx then threw herself from her high rock and died

statement.id: Setelah akhirnya dikalahkan, Sphinx melemparkan diri dari batu tinggi dan mati.
statement.en: Bested at last, the Sphinx threw herself from her high rock and died.

quote: In South India, the "sphinx" is known as puruṣamr̥ga (Sanskrit) or purushamirugam (Tamil), meaning "human-animal". It is found depicted in sculptural art in temples and palaces where it serves an apotropaic purpose

statement.id: Di India Selatan, "sphinx" dikenal sebagai puruṣamr̥ga (Sanskerta) atau purushamirugam (Tamil), "manusia-hewan", dan digambarkan dalam seni pahat di kuil dan istana dengan fungsi penolak bala.
statement.en: In South India the "sphinx" is known as puruṣamr̥ga (Sanskrit) or purushamirugam (Tamil), "human-animal", and is depicted in sculpture in temples and palaces with an apotropaic purpose.

quote: In Burma (Myanmar), the sphinx-like statue, with a human head and two lion hindquarters, is known as Manussiha (manuthiha). It is depicted on the corners of Buddhist stupas, and its legends tell how it was created by Buddhist monks to protect a new-born royal baby from being devoured by ogresses.

statement.id: Di Burma (Myanmar), patung mirip sphinx berkepala manusia dan berbadan belakang singa dikenal sebagai Manussiha; ditempatkan di sudut stupa Buddha, dan legendanya menyebut ia dibuat para biksu untuk melindungi bayi kerajaan dari raksasa betina.
statement.en: In Burma (Myanmar), the sphinx-like statue with a human head and two lion hindquarters is known as Manussiha; it is placed on the corners of Buddhist stupas, and its legends say Buddhist monks created it to protect a newborn royal baby from ogresses.

quote: Nora Nair, Norasingha and Thep Norasingha are three of the names under which the "sphinx" is known in Thailand. They are depicted as upright walking beings with the lower body of a lion or deer, and the upper body of a human.

statement.id: Nora Nair, Norasingha, dan Thep Norasingha adalah tiga nama "sphinx" di Thailand; digambarkan berjalan tegak, berbadan bawah singa atau rusa dan berbadan atas manusia.
statement.en: Nora Nair, Norasingha, and Thep Norasingha are three names of the "sphinx" in Thailand; they are depicted walking upright, with the lower body of a lion or deer and the upper body of a human.

quote: While the date of its construction is not known for certain, the consensus among Egyptologists is that the head of the Great Sphinx bears the likeness of the pharaoh Khafre, dating it to between 2600 and 2500 BC.

statement.id: Meski waktu pembangunannya tidak pasti, konsensus para Egiptolog adalah bahwa kepala Sphinx Agung menyerupai firaun Khafre dan berasal dari antara 2600 dan 2500 SM.
statement.en: Although the date of construction is uncertain, the consensus among Egyptologists is that the head of the Great Sphinx bears the likeness of the pharaoh Khafre, dating it to between 2600 and 2500 BC.

quote: The exact date when the first sphinx appeared is not known and the most famous sphinx of all, the Great Sphinx of Giza, has not been precisely dated; some scholars date it as far back as the reign of Cheops, ca 2500 BCE.

statement.id: Waktu kemunculan sphinx pertama tidak diketahui dan Sphinx Agung Giza belum bisa ditentukan umurnya secara tepat; sebagian sarjana menempatkannya sejak masa Cheops, sekitar 2500 SM.
statement.en: The date of the first sphinx is unknown and the Great Sphinx of Giza has not been precisely dated; some scholars date it as far back as the reign of Cheops, ca 2500 BCE.

quote: In contrast to the Egyptians, the ancient Greeks saw the sphinx as a more troublesome creature.

statement.id: Berbeda dari bangsa Mesir, bangsa Yunani kuno memandang sphinx sebagai makhluk yang lebih merepotkan.
statement.en: In contrast to the Egyptians, the ancient Greeks saw the sphinx as a more troublesome creature.

quote: From the 6th century BCE, the Greek sphinx appeared in stone sculpture, sometimes with raised hind quarters.

statement.id: Sejak abad ke-6 SM, sphinx Yunani muncul dalam pahatan batu, kadang dengan bagian belakang tubuh terangkat.
statement.en: From the 6th century BCE the Greek sphinx appeared in stone sculpture, sometimes with raised hind quarters.

quote: In the Boeotian dialect the name was phix (Hes. Theog. 326), whence the name of the Boeotian mountain, Phikion oros.

statement.id: Dalam dialek Boiotia, namanya adalah phix, dan dari situlah nama gunung Boiotia, Phikion oros.
statement.en: In the Boeotian dialect the name was phix, whence the name of the Boeotian mountain Phikion oros.

quote: However, the historian Susan Wise Bauer suggests that the word "sphinx" was instead a Greek corruption of the Egyptian name "shesepankh", which meant "living image"

statement.id: Sejarawan Susan Wise Bauer mengusulkan bahwa kata "sphinx" justru merupakan perubahan Yunani dari nama Mesir "shesepankh" yang berarti "citra hidup".
statement.en: The historian Susan Wise Bauer suggests the word "sphinx" was instead a Greek corruption of the Egyptian name "shesepankh", meaning "living image".
